intent: How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring, or a half ring, with optional red, amber, and green zones.
useWhen: Task completion with a known percent: uploads, imports, onboarding — when you need zones, a datatip, or indeterminate
A measure against a range, like storage, budget, or a score, where red, amber, and green zones help people judge it
A color the screen decides, like a usage limit going amber and red: set intent
doNotUseWhen: Simple determinate task completion without zones — use Progress
Usage against a plan limit as labeled rows — use UsageList
A short wait of unknown length in the spot that is loading — use Spinner
Placeholder layout while data arrives — use Skeleton
Part-to-whole share across segments — use PieChart

value.note: 0 to 100. Values outside are clamped. indeterminate is for work whose amount done is not known: a short segment slides along a bar, with no percent. Bar only.

label.note: Names it for screen readers, like Storage used.

shape.note: bar fills its container's width. circle is a ring that fills clockwise from the top. semicircle is a bowl: 0 to 100 runs from its left tip, under, to its right tip.

size.note: Bar: space-1 / space-2 / space-3 tall. Circle and semicircle: 56 / 96 / 196 wide.

thresholds.note: Zones are thirds: under 33 is red, under 67 amber, the rest green. none: brand (ink) value on a muted track. bar: the value takes its zone's color. plotArea: the track takes the value's zone color under a brand value. all: the track shows all three bands under a brand value.

intent.note: Sets the value's color outright, whatever thresholds says, when the screen knows what the value means. Leave it out for the brand (ink) value or the threshold zones.

referenceLines.note: Marks at the zone edges, a third and two thirds along.

showValue.note: The rounded percent: after the bar, or inside the ring.

datatip.note: A short note in a tip at the end of the value, like $6,000 of $10,000.

requirements: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin 0 and aria-valuemax 100, named by label
aria-valuetext is the percent, followed by the datatip when there is one
indeterminate leaves out aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext, so screen readers hear it is busy, with no number
The indeterminate segment stops sliding when the person prefers reduced motion; the bar shows a still, faint fill
The drawing is decorative; the percent and datatip text are hidden from screen readers because the progressbar already reads them

doNot: Do not use it for a short wait of unknown length in the spot that is loading — show a Spinner
Do not use indeterminate with circle or semicircle; it is bar only
Do not draw bars or rings from divs or SVG — use Meter or Progress
Do not add a MeterLabel, MeterCircle, or ProgressCircle — pick shape
Do not use intent and thresholds bar together — intent wins; pick one
Do not rely on the zone colors alone; say what the value means in the label, showValue, or datatip
Do not use Meter for simple determinate completion without zones — use Progress
Do not skip prefers-reduced-motion on the indeterminate slide
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
snippet: <Meter label="Budget spent" value={60} thresholds="all" referenceLines datatip="$6,000 of $10,000" />
